_comment: The generator applies these to our copies of Millennium Dawn's focus files.
reward: replacement 'completion_reward' body (tab-indented, no outer braces)
allow:  keep MD's reward but allow pre-completing the focus anyway
(only for focuses verified to be correct in 2026)
Focuses that are not listed and would wreck the 2026 setup stay skipped and

RAJ_bharatiya_janata_party.reason: BJP is the ruling party in 2026 (our history sets its index); MD's reward only boosts its popularity and sets the RAJ_democratic cosmetic tag, which matches the 2026 state.

SOV_putin.reason: Unlocks the Putin branch for a 2026 Russia. The original reward also fires the 2000-era event russia.104 and moves the ruling party to MD's 2000-era Conservative index, contradicting the 2026 United Russia government set by our history patch.

GEO_gergiandream2013.reason: Georgian Dream governs Georgia in 2026, so the branch should be open; the original reward re-sets the ruling party to MD's 2000-era democratic index instead of the 2026 government set by our history patch.

EGY_al_sisi_rise.reason: el-Sisi is already the 2026 president (created by our history patch) and the ruling party is set there; the original reward would create a second el-Sisi leader and reset the ruling party.
EGY_al_sisi_rise.reward:
log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Focus EGY_al_sisi_rise"
			custom_effect_tooltip = sisi_dem_tt
			set_country_flag = EGY_sisi_pisi
